name: a coin moved in costs what the source states it was worth as it arrived
spec: SPEC.md §2 What you enter: units that moved in cost the value the source states on arrival, unless the person states their own
working: 1 BTC bought for 50,000 (Jan 5); 1 BTC transferred in, stated worth 55,000 as it arrived (Jan 6); 2 BTC sold for 120,000 (60,000 each)
first in first out: the bought coin 60,000 − 50,000 = 10,000; the arrived coin 60,000 − 55,000 = 5,000
realized: 15,000 over 2 trades, none left out

name: the person's cost for an arrival wins over the value the source states
spec: SPEC.md §2 What you enter: the person's stated cost comes before the source's stated value
working: 1 ETH transferred in, stated worth 2,500; the person states it cost 2,000 on 2025-06-01; sold for 3,000: P&L 1,000, opened 2025-06-01

name: a staking reward opens a lot at no cost
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade, Crypto: staking rewards open a lot at zero cost and carry a reward flag
working: 0.5 ETH rewarded (cost 0), sold for 1,000: P&L 1,000, marked reward

name: a deposited coin's cost is not on the record: its sale stands as its own trade, left out of the figures
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade, Crypto: a transfer in is a deposit of an asset, basis unknown; that trade stands on its own and is left out of the performance figures
working: 1 BTC bought for 50,000 (Jan 5); 1 BTC transferred in (Jan 6); 2 BTC sold for 120,000 (60,000 each)
first in first out: the bought coin closes at 60,000 → P&L 10,000; the deposited one closes in a round trip of its own whose P&L is not stated
realized: 10,000 over 1 trade, 1 left out

name: a transfer out takes coins at their cost, with no P&L; a residue after a sale is held
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade, Crypto: a transfer out comes off the lots first in first out at their cost, with no P&L
working: 2 BTC bought for 100,000; 0.5 sent out: 25,000 of cost leaves with them, no trade
1.0001 ETH bought for 5,000.50 (5,000 each); 1 sold for 6,000: cost 5,000 → P&L 1,000; 0.0001 ETH left, book 0.50

name: event contracts: bought, and resolved at the cash each resolution states
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade; docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md: event contracts are matched like shares, a resolution closes them at the cash it states
working: E1: 300 bought for 60, resolved for nothing → P&L −60
E2: 100 bought for 40, resolved for 100 → P&L 60

name: a whole holding moved to another of the person's accounts is the same round trip
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, transfers: the lots move with their cost and days; the whole holding keeps its round trip
working: 10 X bought in A for 100; all 10 moved to B (linked); sold in B for 150: one trade opened by the purchase, P&L 50, held in B, 27 days

name: what a holding waits on moves with it to another of the person's accounts
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, the ledger: a holding that waits carries the wait on every figure matched in it
working: A: a purchase of X that states no quantity (the holding waits: quantity-unstated); 10 X bought for 100; all 10 moved to B (linked)
B sells the 10 for 150: the round trip's P&L waits on the same unstated quantity, never 50

name: a linked transfer of more than was held still delivers every unit it moved, the extra at a cost not on the record
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, the ledger: a sale or move of more than held is beyond-held, never dropped
working: A: 6 X bought for 60; 10 moved to B (linked): 4 beyond what A held
B receives all 10: the 6 lots continue the round trip, the 4 are a round trip of their own opened by the receiving transfer, cost waiting (beyond-held)
B sells 10 for 150: 6 at 90 against 60 → P&L 30; 4 at 60 against no stated cost → waits; the sale itself is within what B holds

name: part of a holding moved to another account is a round trip of its own there, keeping the day it was bought
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, transfers and trade identity: a part moved is a new round trip, so no two positions share an id
working: 10 X bought in A for 100 (Jan 5); 4 moved to B (linked, Jan 10)
B sells 4 for 60: its own round trip, opened by the receiving transfer, cost 40 → P&L 20, held from Jan 5 → 27 days
A sells 6 for 90: cost 60 → P&L 30

name: the person's cost for a deposit gives it that cost and day
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md: the person's cost-basis entry for a deposit gives its lots that cost
working: 1 ETH transferred in; the person states it cost 2,000 on 2025-06-01; sold for 3,000: P&L 1,000, opened 2025-06-01

name: a staking reward taken back: the units leave for nothing, their cost a loss
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade, Crypto: staking rewards; docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md: every unit that leaves is matched
working: 1 ETH bought for 2,000; a reward of −0.25 ETH (taken back): 0.25 leaves at 0 against a cost of 500 → −500
0.75 sold for 1,800 against 1,500 → 300; the round trip: −200

name: a holding with two round trips open, a bought coin and a deposited one, lists both
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, positions: a position links to every round trip open in it, the oldest first, and is keyed by the oldest
working: 1 BTC bought for −50,000 (Jan 5), 1 BTC transferred in (Jan 6): one position of 2, its round trips the purchase's and the deposit's, keyed by the purchase
